name: Touchpan Slipstream
description: Wheels the paired files a quarter turn on the inner foot, so both ranks face the new front together.

name: Aegis Ramrod
description: Drops to a knee behind the partner rank's raised barrels so their bodies break the line of fire.

name: Corroding Wheellock
description: Fires the instant the opposite rank's last shot sounds, so the foe never sees the line quiet.

name: Beneficent Barrelband
description: Joins the qi fields of both ranks in one slow breath so each shooter feels the other's reload.

name: Blistering Powder
description: Throws a pulse of qi across the gap between ranks so their shots cross at one angle over the foe.

name: Thorn Serpent
description: Turns both ranks shoulder to shoulder in one move, qi bridging the gap to take a flank volley.

name: Mayhem Flintcock
description: Builds the field of both ranks across a long count and lets go a double sheet of shot over the foe.

name: Charter Lockplate
description: Keeps one rank's fire always rising as the other's falls, until the foe cannot raise a head.

name: Granite Smoke
description: Folds two full volleys from interlocked ranks into one converging blow that clears a wide front of the foe.

name: Sharp Stockbutt
description: Sights along the bare barrel at a far fixed point to confirm it still points true after hard use.

name: Vitalfuze
description: Wipes the bore with an oiled rag on the rod until the metal shines before the next charge.

name: Aim Reckoning
description: Puts a target on the skyline against the clear blue and sends one steady ball into it.

name: Siltfuze
description: Steps back from a closing opponent while the cock is thumbed to full, the piece ready by the last pace.

name: Ramrodruin
description: Clothes the ball in a thin sheet of qi, tightening its flight and its bite on a hard target.

name: Fuzerespite
description: Draws a steady breath of qi into the measured charge so the burn comes even on every shot.

name: Charter Load
description: Cools the barrel with a skin of qi between shots, so rapid firing neither fouls nor warps the bore.

name: Powder Wrath
description: Loads a charge of many small balls and bursts them from the field into a broad pattern at mid range.

name: Rumble Pan
description: Drives a single ball through a shield and the arm behind it with the field packed tight on the shot.

name: Pitiless Prime
description: Condenses the whole field into one ball that breaches plate armour or a plank barricade at the musket's full reach.

name: Verity Bayonetlug
description: Lays the eye on one point of the target, as a hawk does on a single mouse in a field.

name: Might Touchpan
description: Waits motionless for an hour with the field held low, sparing the arms and the nerve for the shot.

name: Smokehavoc
description: Takes the trigger up with a touch as light as a feather until the ball leaves without a tremor.

name: Granite Salvo
description: Slides to a new vantage along the roofline without lifting the barrel above the ridge.

name: Might Load
description: Moves into position along one's own long shadow at dusk so the sun hides the approach.

name: Glint Bayonetlug
description: Fires steeply downward from a height with qi packed behind the ball, piercing a roof or a helm.

name: Nova Prime
description: Reads a runner's stride through the field and fires at the place his chest will be.

name: Fuzeinsight
description: Sends the sense ahead of the ball along the field to feel any drift that might bend its path.

name: Fuzeruin
description: Picks one named man out of a charging file and drops him, the field keeping the ball clear of the others.

name: Loadnerve
description: Bursts a flash of powder and qi in a distant gunner's face, blinding and rattling him for several breaths.

name: Titanic Wheellock
description: Gathers the whole field behind a single ball that finds an exact mark at the full reach past all but solid stone.

name: Might Pan
description: Bends the firing line along the curve of the bank with each file stepping to hold the same angle.

name: Ironpan
description: Presses the chest against a steep cut-bank so enemy balls pass overhead and spend themselves in the water.

name: Daybreak Ramrod
description: Reloads in unbroken motion with the file, each man starting his next step as the one beside him ends his.

name: Verity Lockplate
description: Reads the glints on the water to learn where a hidden foe stands on the far bank.

name: Hellish Barrelband
description: Lays the barrel almost flat on the water's surface and fires so the ball skips toward the far bank.

name: Shade Flintcock
description: Fires each file at a slightly different angle to follow the bend, so the shot covers the whole curve.

name: Unconquered Ramrod
description: Plants the stance against a driving current with qi rooted through the soles so the footing never slips.

name: Might Serpent
description: Steps into the slack water behind a rock to load in calm, qi keeping the hands dry and sure.

name: Aimblink
description: Advances in the shadow of the outer bank, hidden from the far shore until the last curve.

name: Granite Aim
description: Lays fire from both arms of a bend across the same ground on one drawn count of qi.

name: Intentaim
description: Raises a steady wall of fire along the waterline that rises a little with every volley, denying the ford.

name: Corroding Mayhem Powder
description: Sends volley after volley in rising waves along the river's curve, each carried by the field, until the far bank cannot stand.

name: Hoarfrost Stockbutt
description: Drops low inside the hanging smoke of the line so only the muzzle shows over the rim.

name: Healing Lockplate
description: Loads fully inside the cloud, where no sharpshooter can mark the hands.

name: Novaramrod
description: Leans out of the smoke's edge for one shot, then draws back before the foe can answer.

name: Thornpan
description: Feeds qi into the powder smoke before the rank so that it hangs denser and stays longer.

name: Remnant Pan
description: Feels a ball's passing in the cloud through the field and swings the barrel to the place it came from.

name: Impenetrable Wheellock
description: Shapes a swirl of the smoke at the instant of impact so a ball glances off the body's edge.

name: Aegisfuze
description: Builds the line's drifting smoke into a standing bank that hides and softens fire for a long count.

name: Silt Salvo
description: Surges forward out of the cloud on a burst of qi and strikes the foe before he sees the line move.

name: Iron Stockbutt
description: Fuses the smoke of a whole line's volleys into a standing veil that turns musket shot and hides the ranks.

name: Granite Load
description: Moves shooter and loader as one pair, the loader always a half pace to the lock side.

name: Panrespite
description: Passes cartridges and rods between the pair on a fixed rhythm that never needs a word.

name: Chimepan
description: Reads the loader's finger signs for readiness, jam or enemy approach without turning the head.

name: Aegis Bayonetlug
description: Crouches behind the shooter's hip so that the loader keeps working while the shooter takes the front.

name: Vigilant Serpent
description: Hands a second loaded piece over while still taking back the first, qi quickening both hands.

name: Daybreak Barrelband
description: Sweeps the pan clean with a breath of qi and primes it in the same motion, in any weather.

name: Devastating Touchpan
description: Thrusts a spare bayonet under the shooter's arm at a foe who closes, then returns to the load.

name: Salvohavoc
description: Links shooter and loader in one field so aim, fire, hand off and reload run as a single motion.

name: Ironfuze
description: Throws a screen of qi from the loader's field over the shooter at the instant a ball arrives.

name: Merciless Charter Flintcock
description: Sustains continuous fire from a shooter and loader bound in one field, with no gap between shots.

name: Serpent Vitality
description: Notes the bearing of an enemy muzzle flash against a fixed landmark in the instant it shows.

name: Impenetrable Ramrod
description: Drops to one knee at the first crack so the volley that follows passes at head height.

name: Salvo Ruin
description: Fires back at the marked flash before the enemy has finished reloading.

name: Torrent Aim
description: Slides sideways into the nearest hollow or wall, the barrel kept pointed at the marked place.

name: Wheellock Vitality
description: Learns from the pitch of a passing ball's whistle how near and from which side it flew.

name: Murk Pan
description: Tilts the barrel so a ball strikes at a slant and glances away from the body.

name: Chime Bayonetlug
description: Sends a field-guided ball back along the bearing of the flash that was marked.

name: Remnant Flintcock
description: Holds the field open to feel the number and spacing of the enemy line as it loads.

name: Silt Load
description: Surges two paces to the side on qi at the instant the enemy fires, leaving the ball an empty place.

name: Iron Prime
description: Sends a hardened ball through the cover of the enemy's best shot and silences his piece.

name: Unrelenting Touchpan
description: Spreads a veil of drawn qi in front of the line to blunt the next enemy volley.

name: Salvo Scourge
description: Returns a long steady fire on the enemy's firing place until its muskets stop answering.

name: Blaze Barrelband
description: Reads an incoming volley through the field and returns it as one exact counter-volley on the guns that fired.
